values: TOP CUT: Locals to Worlds — Mechanically Implemented Card Catalog
Live catalog audit from data/cards.json (schema v2), verified against CookingCombatService.gd on 2026-07-25
Meals: matching Ingredients are sacrificed; certain Meals also require a Meal sacrifice.
Tools: any discard cost is shown separately. Tools without a discard cost have no additional cost.
Ability/reaction costs are separate from play/serve costs (for example, sacrifice self or discard this Hand Trap).
Runtime Cost mirrors ContentCatalog.gd: Meal recipe slots, otherwise Tool discard cost; the extra Meal sacrifice is excluded.
Base Value is the campaign rarity value. Shop price is dynamic and can be higher with metagame demand.
All 35 structured effect types declared in the live catalog have matching resolver paths in CookingCombatService.gd.
The Fresh Ingredient Token is runtime-generated and therefore listed separately from the 89 collectible cards.
